# Green Control Design System

> The design system behind AI GC · Green Control, an AI that watches a building's energy plant with the people who run it. Rule zero: evidence first, people decide. The AI may look, compare and suggest; anything that changes a machine waits for a person, shows why, and can be undone.

## Files

- [DESIGN.md](files/DESIGN.md): the idea, the look, the AI states, the confidence bands and the five rules, in plain words.
- [SKILL.md](files/SKILL.md): an agent skill. Load it before creating or changing any Green Control screen; it ends with a checklist.
- [tokens.json](files/tokens.json): colours, type, space, radius, motion and the AI confidence thresholds, in W3C Design Tokens (DTCG) format. Night is the default value; day is in $extensions.
- [shell.html](files/shell.html): the screen shell every equipment screen starts from: rail, stage with the figure and evidence row, AI panel.
- [gc-stage.css](files/gc-stage.css): dot field, pool glow, labels and numbered marks on the drawing, evidence row.
- [gc-assemble.js](files/gc-assemble.js): the particle assemble that builds a figure from its points when a screen opens.
- [gc-tokens.css](files/gc-tokens.css): every token as gc-* CSS variables, night and day.
- Components added in 1.3 (owner row, causes list, suggested check, art box) are in gc-stage.css and green-control-components.css.
- Figures: draw equipment with the anatomy-figure skill (isometric line art, one part lit in the accent).
- [registry.json](r/registry.json): shadcn-format registry.
  - [green-control-theme](r/green-control-theme.json): every token as CSS variables, light = day, dark = night.
  - [green-control-components](r/green-control-components.json): CSS for the AI components. Depends on the theme.

Install: `npx shadcn@latest add https://shuyii0315-arch.github.io/green-control/system/r/green-control-theme.json https://shuyii0315-arch.github.io/green-control/system/r/green-control-components.json`

## Rules an agent must follow

1. Show at least one evidence chip before any plan. One card per real check; tag cards with this topic's questions, not a fixed What/Where/Why.
2. Confidence 80+: plan with Apply. 50–79: draft, evidence open, Review before Apply. Below 50: no plan, suggest a check.
3. Never change equipment without a person's tap. Every applied step gets a toast with Undo.
4. Use the spark icon only where the AI speaks or acts.
5. Build every equipment screen around an isometric drawing of the machine (anatomy-figure), with the dot field and the assemble.
6. Tokens only. Square corners. One accent per screen. Build night and day.
